purpose: Runtime/editor overlay contract for visualizing generated worldgen footprints, blocked cells, interaction zones, transitions, and placement previews.

overlays.meaning: full sprite/visual bounds, including multi-tile trees, facades, tables, bars, cave entrances, and greenhouse markers
tiles that block actor movement or object placement
walkability result after tile collision and object collision are combined
tiles that respond to interact/use actions
selected object can be committed at cursor
selected object has placement issues at cursor

placementRules: Object anchor must be inside the 96x64 scene.
Visual footprint must remain inside the scene for editor placement.
Blocking collision footprint must be inside the scene.
Blocking collision footprint must not sit on non-walkable terrain.
Interaction footprint must remain inside the scene.
Object footprints may not overlap existing object visual/collision/interaction rectangles during editor placement.
